backend/main.mo: Defines the main Motoko canister with authorization mixins, storage, admin password, pairing logic, profiles, schedules, filters, activities, locations, and audit log types, plus in‑memory maps for all core state.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries linking specific frontend files to implemented behaviors around admin‑role reveal via phone number and role‑selection consistency.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short descriptions of numerous frontend source files covering authentication, dashboards, polling, pairing, admin gating, UI components, and child/parent functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base layer defining light/dark theme tokens and global styling variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the app root, manifest, icons, and main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest configuring app metadata, icons, theme, categories, and display settings.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing caching, cache cleanup, fetch fallback, and background sync for queued location updates.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication, role‑based routing, admin gating, heartbeat, profile setup, and global providers.
frontend/src/components/account/AccountD: Renders an account dropdown with actions for changing photo, password, viewing policies, and deleting the account, with role labeling and dialog controls.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePa: Modal dialog guiding users to change their password via Internet Identity with explanations and external link.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePr: Dialog for uploading, previewing, saving, or removing a profile photo with validation and progress handling.
frontend/src/components/account/DeleteAc: Confirmation dialog requiring typing DELETE to remove an account, with warnings and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/account/UserAvat: Displays a user's avatar using their profile photo or generated initials, with size options.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Empty placeholder file for an admin accounts table component.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Admin access gate allowing password verification and password changes with validation and allowlist checks.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Fetches and displays admin dashboard metrics as a grid of metric cards with icons and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Displays a child's daily activity total against their limit and allows requesting more time when over limit.
Shows a parent's view of a child's daily activity usage with alerts for exceeding limits.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Fetches and displays sorted audit log entries with action labels, executor info, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides login/logout handling with Internet Identity, including retry logic and UI state indicators.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Form for setting a user profile and optionally unlocking admin role via phone check and password verification.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Lists a child's submitted activities in a sortable table with optional transparency label and refetching.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Allows children to submit activity and location updates, toggle live location sharing, and handle related UI state.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Shows a consent notice for activity, location, or pairing actions with contextual icons and text.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Displays a child's location history with sorting, filtering by limit, and optional transparency label, using tabbed controls and table output.
frontend/src/components/child/PairWithPa: Provides UI for pairing a child account with a parent via code or phone number, handling validation, mutations, and polling for pairing status.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: Allows parents to edit a child's content filter settings including category toggles and custom allow/block lists, and save updates.
Shows a read‑only view of a child's configured content filter, listing blocked/allowed categories and items.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Dropdown menu for switching application language between supported locales.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: Footer displaying app name, transparency policy link, and attribution with external caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Header showing app branding, user controls, language/theme toggles, login, and transparency access.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Wraps the activity history list for a child with a transparency disclaimer alert.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Summarizes a child's recent activity and location counts with selectable card UI.
frontend/src/components/parent/LiveLocat: Displays the child's latest known location on a map, handles loading states, stale data detection, and links to Google Maps.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Provides tabs for viewing a child's live map and location history with an informational alert.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: Generates and displays a parent–child pairing code with copy support and warning messaging.
frontend/src/components/parent/ParentPho: Allows parents to view, edit, validate, and save their phone number within their profile.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Enables parents to set daily screen-time limits and manage allowed time windows for a child.
Shows a child's configured screen‑time limits and allowed time windows in a non-editable format.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Implements a simple session-based gate to control admin access.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Provides access to the app's internationalization context.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading, login, logout, and tracking login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveLocationSharin: Implements periodic geolocation capture with retries, background sync, queue processing, and visibility-based behavior for live location sharing.
Sends periodic and visibility-triggered heartbeat requests using the authenticated actor to indicate user presence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data such as profiles, admin checks, metrics, and account management.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Provides a context-based internationalization system with language persistence, translation lookup, and parameter substitution.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports locale types, supported locales, and translation dictionaries for the i18n system.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: Contains English translation strings for UI text, covering authentication, profile setup, navigation, dialogs, and general labels.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Provides Brazilian Portuguese translations for UI text across authentication, profile setup, menus, and various app sections.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark navy-themed color schemes.
frontend/src/lib/leafletMarkerIcon.ts: Empty file placeholder for Leaflet marker icon utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app root with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Displays the admin dashboard with metrics, system management tabs, and translated titles.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Child home dashboard showing check-ins, history, schedule, filters, alerts, and pairing status.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard for managing children, pairing requests, activity, schedules, filters, and alerts.
Renders a modal-style transparency and policies page using translated text and UI components.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Implements service worker registration and helpers for background and periodic sync support.
frontend/src/utils/liveLocationCapabilit: Defines capability detection for geolocation, service workers, and PWA background behavior, plus a helper to generate user-facing capability messages.
frontend/src/utils/locationUpdateQueue.t: Implements a localStorage‑backed queue for location updates with retry handling and size limits.
frontend/src/utils/phoneNumber.ts: Provides phone number normalization, validation, formatting, parsing, and allowlist comparison utilities.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions to read, store, persist, and clear URL parameters from query strings or hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the frontend project.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, architectural notes, known issues, and feature request statuses.
